headline: Stock market opening 1 October – BUX in freefall, OTP continues to plunge
summary: Trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange was negative at Thursday's opening, with the BUX weaker and standing at 143,867.34 points after the first hour. OTP shares continued to plunge.
why: The BUX is the benchmark index of the Budapest Stock Exchange, and OTP Bank is Hungary's largest listed lender, so moves in both reflect Hungarian market sentiment.
why_moved: The BUX opened weaker and was at 143,867.34 points after the first hour, with OTP Bank shares continuing to fall during the negative session.
